brief:
Ralph Lauren faced renewed boycott calls after the American fashion brand featured Israeli actress Gal Gadot in promotional materials for its fall 2026 collection, Shehab Wire reported. The appearance of the Israeli performer in the campaign sparked a wave of criticism and mobilized calls for a consumer boycott against the company.

The controversy reignited longstanding debate over celebrity endorsements and corporate political positioning. Ralph Lauren's decision to feature Gadot in the fall collection materials drew particular attention amid ongoing regional tensions and heightened sensitivities surrounding brand partnerships with Israeli public figures.
